ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Visible surface presents a high-contrast bimodal distribution; ratio of high-intensity white (approx. intensity >200) to low-intensity black (approx. intensity <50) pixels is approximately 0.45:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large high-intensity white contiguous segments located on distal lobes; transition from central low-intensity black to distal white is characterized by high-frequency stippling and mottling; distinct tan-hued pixel cluster observed on left lobe upper-mid quadrant; several dark focal spots embedded in white distal regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped indentation; vertex angle measured at approximately 38 degrees; depth is significant, extending approximately 20% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated boundary; right lobe distal portion shows 3-4 distinct notches of depth exceeding 5 pixels; left lobe maintains a more consistent micro-serration pattern across the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobe trailing edges follow a convex parabolic curve from the median notch to the sharp distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Scattered low-intensity circular clusters (3-5 pixels diameter) detected within the white regions of both lobes, particularly near the stippled transition zones.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Four distinct horizontal/diagonal dark line segments (ranging 15-30 pixels in length) present on the right lobe's white surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant non-monochromatic tan/ochre staining on the left lobe white region; irregular jagged indentation and structural loss at the extreme tip of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The localized chromatic shift to tan on the left lobe is a highly unique visual marker not consistent with standard grayscale pigmentation.
